scope: October 13, 2025 Law: common rules, Standard Setup, Marquise de Cat, Eyrie Dynasties, Woodland Alliance, one base Vagabond (Thief/Tinker/Ranger), Fall/Autumn and Winter, dominance and coalitions.
excluded: Expansion faction systems and characters, second Vagabond, other maps, hirelings, landmarks, bots, Advanced Setup.
method: Fresh independent source comparison of the supplied summary against all applicable Law sections. PDF checked directly with PyMuPDF for edition structure, base components, base characters and battle wording. No questions, answer key, reader outputs, grades, earlier audit reports or other QA files were consulted. Summary was not edited.

checked_claims.details: Summary confines play rules to October 13, 2025 common Law, Standard Setup, base factions and characters, Fall/Winter, dominance and coalitions.
Listed base component totals and types match C.1; items are neither faction-owned nor enemy faction pieces.
Random start/seating, zero scores, three hand cards, two-player dominance removal, four ruins, separate map item supply, dice, and faction setup order are represented.
Map supply is 2 boots, 2 bags, 1 crossbow, 1 hammer, 2 swords, 2 tea, 2 coins; R items are populated only in Vagabond setup and remain distinct from S starting items.
Base values and recommendations 17/18/21 for 2/3/4 players, plus adventurous 17+ allowance, match source.
Keep corner, garrison exception, starting buildings and track fill match source.
Unoccupied starting corner, diagonal preference when possible, six warriors, roost, chosen leader, Viziers and remaining track roosts match.
Ten warriors, matching bases and sympathy track, three additional supporters; hand and supporters are distinct.
Forest pawn, three displayed quests, concealed R items, S-marked starting items, unused S return and Indifferent markers match.
Clockwise Birdsong/Daylight/Evening, start/end timing, end-turn restriction, compound March and exceptions to noninterruption match.
Current player resolves otherwise unclear choices; attacker orders competing before/after-roll effects; forced player retains abilities and battle decisions.
Bird wild substitution, forced bird matching and no reverse substitution; immediate reshuffle; public hand count/private contents; searchable face-up piles; transfer and consent restrictions match.
Warriors plus buildings, Eyrie ties, pawn/token exclusion; positive moving group, adjacent path, rule at an end, repeat moves and placement distinction match.
Clearing suits/slots, ruin blocking/removal, forest adjacency, Autumn without special rules and Winter river dividing forests match.
Craft icons rather than card suit; piece suit/once-per-turn; item supply availability and scoring; persistent play area and duplicate limit; ambush/dominance uncraftability match.
Enemy and presence requirement; matching optional ambush and foil; two immediate hits and early termination; before-roll/roll/after-roll/count/deal sequence match.
Rolled caps, reversed Alliance dice, uncapped extra hits, ignored hits, defenseless bonus, warriors-before-cardboard, removal-effect choice and building/token points match.
Finite pieces and maximal partial manipulation do not waive costs/prerequisites; simultaneous removal precedes triggers; tracks and permanent item removal; replace and swap distinctions match.
Keep permits only Marquise placement but allows enemy movement; no replacement keep; hospitals use matching clearing card for removed Marquise warriors and require keep destination.
Wood per sawmill; workshop craft before three actions plus spent birds; battle/March/recruit once/build/overwork; full wood cost via ruled chain; evening draw bonuses and five-card limit match.
Empty hand emergency card, mandatory 1–2 additions with at most one bird, New Roost eligible-clearing rule; roost crafting then all cards in column order; action suits and constraints match.

Immediate turmoil on failure to fully resolve; bird VP loss including Viziers; purge except Viziers; replacement and leader recycling; Daylight end; Evening score/draw; all four leader columns/abilities match.
Separate face-down suit-only supporters, capacity five without bases/unlimited otherwise, overflow discard; removed-base matching birds, half officers rounded up, then excess supporters match.
Other-player sympathy removal or movement of warriors triggers one matching hand card per move/removal; birds included; no-match hand show and supporter draw; placement/pawn distinction match.

All Revolts precede Spread Sympathy; revolt sympathetic matching available base, two supporters, all enemy removal, base/warrior/officer sequence; no invented placement prerequisite; sympathy adjacency, printed cost, one-player martial-law threshold and scoring match.
Craft/Mobilize/hand-card Train freely; officers limit operations; Move/Battle/Recruit/Organize details, no supporter cost or adjacency for Organize; draw bonuses and hand limit match.
Unremovable pawn and three-item damage for full enemy removal; independent face/damage states; exhaustion requires ready undamaged item; track movement/capacity; hit damage and ignored excess match.

Tea count excludes tea refreshed this step; then three refreshes; optional free Slip including Hostile clearings and movement-out restriction exception; normal boot/hostile surcharge and forest restrictions match.

Sword battle, torch Explore/VP/ruin removal, item+card Aid and optional crafted item, two-item Quest/reward/replacement, crossbow Strike hierarchy, hammer Repair preserving face, matching hammers/pawn crafting and supply match.
Same-turn per-step Aid count with no double counting, printed advance VP, two VP for subsequent Allied Aid, and Hostile Aid inability to restore relations match.

One ally per move or attacking battle; forced movement restrictions; no allied warriors against themselves; combined sword/warrior cap; optional allied hit absorption and strict-greater-than item-loss hostility at battle end match.

First removed non-Hostile warrior triggers Hostile subject to allied-hit exception; only own-turn battle grants Infamy, excluding first warrior; normal cardboard points added; Strike excluded; hostile-warrior entry costs extra boot match.

Forest Rest repairs/refreshes damaged items only; draw still follows and uses face-up coins; hand discard before capacity; capacity includes Satchel plus Damaged, six plus two per tracked bag; permanent removal matches.
Thief/Tinker/Ranger starting items and torch actions match; Tinker may take birds; Ranger repairs three preserving faces and immediately transitions to Evening.

Immediate 30 VP and clockwise simultaneous tie; dominance own-Daylight 10 VP activation, score cessation, immutable card, start-Birdsong suit or opposite-corner rule; special discard destination and matching-card acquisition including bird requirement match.

Vagabond substitutes coalition for ordinary dominance in 4+ players subject to normal activation timing/threshold; lowest-score noncoalition partner/tie choice; joint victory; nonenemy status; Hostile reset but no automatic Allied status match.

No materially necessary within-scope action, timing, payment, limit, scoring rule, destination, exception or end condition was found absent or contradicted. Printed board costs/VP/draw bonuses are correctly delegated to the physical faction tracks.

source_limitations: The Law defers numeric faction-track costs, VP and draw bonuses to faction boards; the summary also instructs readers to use those boards. The PDF does not itself enumerate the physical battle dice face values. These do not create an essential rule gap in this summary.
